PEAR PHP installer go-pear.phar compromised on server

Target: pear
Repository: N/A
Date: 2018-06-20 to 2019-01-19 (213 days)
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Library
Language: PHP
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Unauthorized Access/Control
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote code execution
User Impact:
Domain: pear.php.net (project download host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The official go-pear.phar installer on pear.php.net was replaced with a malicious version and left in place for roughly six months. Anyone bootstrapping PEAR from the trusted server risked executing a backdoored installer, a thin bootstrap script turned into a long-lived foothold.
